content: The EcuM_SetState function shall set the EcuM State to the value of the State parameter. If the State parameter is not a valid value, the EcuM_SetState function shall not change the State and if Development Error Reporting is turned on, the EcuM_SetState function shall additionally send an ECUM_E_STATE_PAR_OUT_OF_RANGE error message to the DET module.
